generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Satisfactory Completion of work as a prime contractor for at least one similar work to an extent of 50% of the cost of the work in the last 5 Years. (2020-21 to 2025-26)

last year turnover is more than 20 lakhs, GST copy is mandatory. If registered. Copy may be submitted.

Part A: Frame which is made out of MS L-angle section of 25x25x3mm fabricated to suit the solar PV module also painted with anti-rust coat.
Module stand is tilted to an angle of 12 degree placed North side-upwards & South downwards
which will help the module to capture Solar radiations. Part B: Is made of 50NB GI pipe as per IS standards with fastners to fasten the stand on top of the post.
Bottom of the pipe is firmly fixed by concreting below the ground to a depth of 0.6m.

6(a)(i)Painting with black anti-corrosive bitumastic paint of approved brand and manufacture to give an even shade :One coats on old work as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer in charges

Consists of Housing box and Stand:
A. Housing Box: Double Gel Battery Box: Console cabinet of size 600mm (Length) x 630mm (Depth including door) x 860mm(Height including canopy) made with body entirely made of 22 SWG MS sheet and door and bottom made with 20 SWG MS sheet duly spray painted. The door shall be protected with gasket and provision to fix external lock and two camlocks installed. A wire hanger shall be provided at the back to support excess wire and attachments. The inner layout shall consist of a shelf in between with depth of 300mm and a holder plate to mount system. Should be coated with Anti rusting paint to withstand all weather conditions to suit outdoor installation. B. Stand: Made of MS L-angle 25*25*3mm fabricated to suit the size of Housing box. Should be provided with fastners to interlock housing box. Stand should be firmly fixed to the ground by concreting all four legs.

Raiser post consists of Part-A: Vertical pipes of 4.25 height- 50mmx50mmx2mm thick respectively. Part-B: Horizontal T-frame of 0.9m length & 50mmx50mmx2mm thick fabricated to suit and to lock with vertical post & post guard. Both the posts are GI Square Hallow Pipe. These pipes are manufactured conforming to IS-1239 (Part-1) 1990 Horizontal T-frame is mounted on vertical raiser using suitable bolt & nut. [To work out the steel qunatity, density of Galvanized iron is considered as 7850kg/m3 Total no's considered is 60No's for 1km]

Elephant post guard is provided to protect Post from elephant attack and is extended at the end
of T-frame for 4ft & at the centre as well (as shown in dwg) by using suitable size pipe with the help of bolt and nut SS wire is interlinked at all four ends of guard pipe & SS wire rope is suspended at equal intervals
It is made of 15mmx15mmx1.2mmthick non rusting quality of GI pipe as per Indian Standards. [ Quantity = 2No's per raiser post,
total =2*60=80No's]

Made of 75x75x2mm wall thickness, ISI make GP or GA Square pipe. The pipes are manufactured conforming to IS- 1239 (Part-l) I 990 which has inner size of 71mm at both sides. Length is 0.85m, wherein 0.60m is concreted below the ground to hold Raiser post firmly in the ground. [Quantity is worked out for 60No's for 1km]
